entities.summary: Nicolas-Marie Songis des Courbons, Count of the Empire,, was a French artillery commander during the French Revolutionary Wars, who rose to the rank of General of Division in 1800 and served as commander of the Grande Armée artillery between 1805 and 1809, during the Napoleonic Wars.
